visual_observations: Pricing table at 360px shows visible truncation in the right-hand column. '800 MICRON' header reads as 'BO MICRO'; price cells under it read as '£29 £5.9 each' / '£32 £3.4 each' — both the £### total and the £#.## unit price look truncated mid-character, suggesting the column is narrower than its content.

Three columns of prices (300/500/800 MICRON) on a 360px viewport gives ~95-100px per column after the leading 'TOTAL QUANTITY' column — too tight for a £###.## total + £#.## each + 'each' label stacked vertically. P0 risk: customer cannot read prices for the thickest variant.
Masthead (logo + PROOF VIEWER + PL · 3264463649) fits cleanly with no clipping.
'PROOF FOR / Matthew Latifi' display heading wraps to two lines, looks intentional and readable.
Material spec block (MATERIAL / REVISION / NAME rows) is tidy.
Single proof image fills the column with comfortable padding; Download chip sits under filename caption with appropriate spacing — but the chip itself fails the touch target check.
Specification table (MATERIAL / SIDES / FINISH / NAMES ON CARD / REVISION) reads cleanly with two-column layout.
Pricing card 'Need a price for a specific quantity?' lookup input is a tall single-line text input with adequate touch target.
Disclaimer / 'Please check this proof carefully' section reads well on narrow viewports — the 'I've read this and understand the terms' checkbox label is visible and well-spaced.
Footer 'M PLASMADESIGN / PL · 3264463649 · V1' fits within viewport.
